caption: MCP Tool Choice
description: Controls tool selection behavior for sampling requests. Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2025-11-25 ToolChoice; 2026-07-28 ToolChoice).
name: mcp_tool_choice

mcp_mode.description:
MCP member `mode`: Controls the tool use ability of the model:
- "auto": Model decides whether to use tools (default)
- "required": Model MUST use at least one tool before completing
- "none": Model MUST NOT use any tools

mcp_additional_members.description: Members the pinned definition does not name, exactly as reported, in source order.
